content: Weight management plays a critical role in the care of individuals diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, and prediabetes, especially in those who are classified as overweight or obese. A weight reduction of 5-10% of total body weight is strongly recommended, as it has been shown to improve cardiovascular health and contribute to a significant reduction in hemoglobin A1C levels. Engaging in intensive weight management interventions that include regular and frequent follow-up appointments has been demonstrated to result in better clinical outcomes for patients. For patients who require substantial weight loss and meet the appropriate clinical criteria, bariatric surgery may be considered as a viable therapeutic option.
